summary: John sees in right hand of him who sits on throne scroll sealed with seven seals, no one worthy in heaven earth under earth to open scroll or look, John weeps, one elder says don't weep, Lion of tribe of Judah Root of David overcame to open scroll. Then sees in middle of throne Lamb as though slain, with seven horns seven eyes which are seven spirits, takes scroll, four living creatures and twenty-four elders fall with harps and bowls of incense which are prayers, sing new song worthy are you to take scroll because you were slain and bought for God with blood people from every tribe language people nation and made them kingdom priests. Then thousands of thousands of angels, every created thing, worship Lamb, blessing.
whyItMatters: Centerpiece of Revelation — who is worthy to open history? Answer not Lion as expected but Lamb slain, whose death purchases diverse people and makes them priests. Song culminates in worship of Lamb as creation's center.

keyVerses.text: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”
keyVerses.why: Lion then Lamb paradox — expected conquering lion, see slain lamb who overcame precisely by being slain.

keyVerses.text: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,
keyVerses.why: New song reason — worthy because slain and purchased diverse people.

keyVerses.text: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”
keyVerses.why: Universal worship — to Lamb and to throne, equal honor.

questions.question: What is scroll sealed with seven seals no one worthy to open?
questions.answer: Scroll = will, plan, history's meaning. Seven seals = completely sealed, no one can open. Question who worthy in heaven, on earth, under earth, in sea — fourfold creation — no one. John weeps because if no one opens, history remains closed, no justice, no resolution. Scroll contains what must take place (later chapters). Worthiness to open means worthiness to unfold God's purposes.

questions.question: Why Lion of Judah then Lamb as though slain? Is it bait and switch?
questions.answer: Elder says Lion of tribe of Judah, Root of David overcame — Jewish expectation: conquering lion king who defeats enemies. John looks and sees Lamb as though slain — surprise: victory through being slain, not slaying. Seven horns = complete power, seven eyes = complete sight/Spirit. Paradox central to Revelation — power redefined as sacrificial love that overcomes. Lion was Lamb all along.

questions.question: What does 'bought for God with blood people from every tribe language people nation' mean?
questions.answer: Marketplace language — bought from slave market (agorazo). Blood is currency. People from every tribe (phyle), language (glossa), people (laos), nation (ethnos) — fourfold diversity echoing Babel and Pentecost. Made them kingdom and priests (v10) — Exodus 19 kingdom of priests fulfilled but now inclusive. Not tribal deity but universal purchase.

questions.question: Why do four living creatures and twenty-four elders have harps and bowls of incense which are prayers of saints?
questions.answer: Harps = worship, bowls of incense = prayers (Psalm 141:2). In temple, incense offered as prayers ascend. Image: prayers of saints (persecuted churches) are collected and become part of heavenly worship that triggers scroll opening. Your prayers matter — stored, not forgotten, part of cosmic liturgy leading to justice.

questions.question: What does thousands of thousands angels and every creature worshipping Lamb mean?
questions.answer: Angels number myriads = 10,000 x 10,000 — innumerable. Then every created thing in heaven, on earth, under earth, on sea and all in them — fourfold creation again, now worshiping not beast but Lamb and him who sits on throne together, with same blessing honor glory dominion. Climax: whole creation's worship restored around Lamb who was slain. Contrast to empire worship of Caesar.

glossary.def: Completely sealed scroll — seven = completeness, unopenable by unworthy.

glossary.term: Lion of Judah Root of David
glossary.def: Messianic titles — Judah's lion king, David's root — conquering hope.
